scope: Bounded read-only pinned public ELF and frozen alphabet source review. No compile, benchmark/test execution, source or Git mutation.
source_binding_limit: Pinned SHA and the two supplied frozen sources verified. Whole-source complete-check/family status and runtime exact-output proof remain parent-owned.

ordinary_route.small_route: support<64 inline literal_alphabet.reference fused insertion; no large-helper call or large scratch parameter
ordinary_route.large_live_threshold: after nonzero filter and already_ordered check,0x1213312 cmp live,64;0x1213317 jae key/radix
ordinary_route.already_ordered: initial nonzero frequencies monotonically descend;0x12132f0–0x1213304 branches to ascending-symbol copy without keys
ordinary_route.large_support_small_live: When support>=64 but live<64 and not already_ordered, helper performs insertion over filtered live list; helper frame was already reserved.

frequency_reads.initial_filter: u8 support symbol load then u32 frequency load e.g0x1213262/0x1213268
frequency_reads.key_build: u8 filtered tree symbol then complete u32 frequency load e.g0x1213430/0x1213436
frequency_reads.small_insertion: current supported symbol and earlier alphabet symbols, which were populated only from supported nonzero symbols
frequency_reads.supported_contract: Support strictly ascending and unique, with <=256 symbols; assertions are contract/debug checks, not runtime validation of arbitrary malformed support in ReleaseFast.

radix.full_complement_width: 0x1213436 u32 load;0x121343a NOT r10d;0x121343d 64-bit SHL8; symbol OR0x1213441
radix.sort_direction: ascending complemented frequency = descending original frequency
radix.stable_symbol_ties: Input live tree_symbols is strictly ascending by symbol; frequency-only stable LSD passes preserve this order for equal complete u32 frequencies.
radix.variation: OR(key XOR key0) over live keys
radix.counting: Scalar SHRX/extract-u8 followed by u16 incw counts; four-way unrolled loops
radix.prefix: u16 positions built from u16 counts, values0..256
radix.stable_scatter: 0x1213860 source key order;positions[digit] load;destination[index] fullkey store;incrementpositions before next source key
radix.buffer_parity: keys and temporary alternate only on executed passes;odd parity finalmemcpy at0x1214235, length8*live
radix.vector_stores_role: Some vector writes zero fixed count scratch; radix extraction/count/scatter are scalar.

output.tree_symbols: Filtered ascending support retained; only liveprefix written; nonzero count stored asu16
output.alphabet: After optional sorting, low symbolbyte extracted from each key and written asu16 e.g0x1214250/58; alphabet.len stored0x12142e6
output.unique_and_complete_scope: Under unique support contract, filter contains every supported nonzero symbol once; radix moves full keys and output extracts symbols, no additional symbols. Static implementation invariant, not an executed full-output oracle.
output.inactive_tail: Outside live prefixes source intentionally leaves previous bytes untouched.
output.ties: frequency ties preserve ascending original symbol order; no lossy frequency key or numeric narrowing.

actual_internal_abi.large: rdi frequencies; rsi supportptr; rdx supportlen; rcx alphabetptr; r8 tree_symbolsptr; u16 Error returninax

local_stack.large_stable_rsp_relative_rbp: rbp-0x1640 (five non-rbp saved registers40B plus explicitsub5656)
local_stack.additional_copy: Four fixed512B memcpy sites copy counts to compiler temporary before prefix; these are local scratch copies, not heap/rawinput copies.
local_stack.limit: Explicitsub and observed scratch bases only; not Cache/workspace sizeof, complete stack/call-chain peak, heap or RSS.

limitations: No current tests/benchmark executed; no exact correctness proof for all input/support combinations.
No throughput, SIMD ranking, bandwidth, heap/RSS or full-stack peak claim.
Untrusted support contract violations are not promised safe/valid by static ReleaseFast audit.
Pinned identity and frozen sources are not whole family/check pass assertions.
